主要内容: On February 25, 2016, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. appointed Jeffrey J. Keenan as a director and member of the Audit Committee, both effective as of February 25, 2016. Mr. Keenan will receive the Company’s standard compensation for non-employee directors. He has no family relationships with any director or executive officer of the Company, and there were no arrangements or understandings with any person pursuant to which he was selected as a director. Additionally, there have been no transactions directly or indirectly involving Mr. Keenan that would be required to be disclosed under Regulation S-K. The appointment was signed by Greerson G. McMullen, General Counsel and Secretary, on March 2, 2016.
